title: CursorHide breaks the input in the game

judgment.rationale: The simultaneous movement/key-hold symptom matches the existing CursorHide stutter report #51858; Skyrim and the Arma 3 follow-up add useful game-specific reproductions to that investigation.
evidence: The reporter supplies a 0.102.3101 ZIP, Windows 10, elevated execution, and Skyrim SE/SKSE versions.
Holding WASD while moving the mouse lowers sensitivity; releasing movement keys restores it.
A second user reports the same with Arma 3 and says disabling CursorHide resolves it: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/52141#issuecomment-6884492067
Read #51858: holding any key while moving the pointer causes stutter, with a second user noting severity increases with multiple keys.
Current AutoHideCursorState alternates hide on nonmodifier keydown and show on intentional mouse movement; worker actions are queued, so synchronous hook mutation is not established.
Open recovery PR #51547 focuses on missed movement/unavailable-position recovery, not demonstrated simultaneous-input pacing.
judgment.recommended_action: Consolidate the Skyrim/Arma evidence with #51858 and reproduce that input sequence before selecting game-capture detection or transition coalescing.

reproduce.title: Verify reported CursorHide behavior
prerequisites: Use a Windows system supported by the tested PowerToys version.
steps: Use the Skyrim SE/SKSE or Arma 3 setup described in this report and enable CursorHide.
Hold movement keys while moving the mouse, then release the keys without stopping mouse movement.
Repeat with CursorHide disabled and compare the same control sequence.
Record this game-specific result with the canonical key-hold/movement investigation #51858.
reproduce.expected_result: Simultaneous held-key/mouse input remains responsive, with no CursorHide-dependent loss of movement or sensitivity.
